name: TagScopeTerm
description: Specifies a tag-based condition that determines whether an S3 object is included or excluded from a classification job.

allOf.description: The operator to use in the condition. Valid values are EQ (equals) or NE (not equals).
The object property to use in the condition. The only valid value is TAG.

The tag keys or tag key and value pairs to use in the condition. To specify only tag keys in a condition, specify the keys in this array and set the value for each associated tag value to an empty string.
The type of object to apply the condition to.
